user.title: HomeKit Wi-Fi Provisioning
user.description: Optionally set the network accessories should join. Leave empty to let each ESPHome radio use its own Wi-Fi. Required for the host's own Wi-Fi radio.

confirm.title: Put {name} on Wi-Fi?
confirm.description: {manufacturer} {model} ({wac_id}) is waiting for Wi-Fi. The nearest radio will send it your network's credentials. Afterwards, pair it from the HomeKit Device card.

progress.provisioning: Sending Wi-Fi credentials via {radio} and waiting for the accessory to join the network. This can take up to two minutes.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already set up. Unconfigured accessories appear as discovered devices.
abort.already_configured: This accessory is ignored or already handled.
abort.wifi_provisioned: {name} is on Wi-Fi. Serial: {serial}. Model: {model}. Firmware: {firmware}. Pair it from the HomeKit Device discovery card.
